art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Sett is an adult muscular vastaya with short red hair, small furred animal ears, strong brows, and a broad jaw. A fully covering dark shirt and trousers sit beneath his red fur-collared coat, with large gold knuckle guards, wrapped wrists, a belt, and heavy boots preserving his recognizable equipment.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: crimson, warm gold, lilac pencil shadow, brown; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
